_doc: Infeasibility scenario: budget too tight to satisfy min_compounding + min_fast_feedback simultaneously. Solver should return UNSAT with named labels.
_expected_outcome: Unsat core contains 'budget_cap' + (min_compounding OR min_fast_feedback). User-facing message should suggest raising budget or relaxing a floor.
_optimum_note: Compounding requires seo_onpage ($3K min). Fast-feedback requires linkedin ($8K) or email ($5K). Cheapest feasible = $3K + $5K = $8K > $6K budget.
